profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Dart | Flutter | C# | ASP.Net Core | Mobile Development
profile.jobTitle: Development Team Lead | Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer focused on mobile development, I build mobile and web applications using Flutter and ASP.Net Core. I have 4+ years of experience in developing apps with state-of-the-art technologies and architectures, such as BLoC, GetX, Provider, GetIt, RxDart, Firebase, GraphQL, Clean Architecture, and Design Patterns. I also use Codemagic and Azure DevOps for CI/CD and agile project management. 

I am passionate about learning new skills and improving it to the next level. I have a degree in Computer Engineering from "Jose Marti" University , where I studied various programming languages, databases, and frameworks. 

I am flexible, detail-oriented, and able to work independently and with teams. I enjoy collaborating with clients and colleagues to deliver high-quality products that solve real-world problems.

positions.title: Development Team Lead | Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
Flutter: BLoC, Provider (State Management). DI with GetIt. Reactive Programming with RxDart. Route
Management with AutoRoute.
• Integration with GraphQL
• CI/CD with Codemagic and GitLab pipelines.
• Experience in App responsive layout implementation and optimization.
• Use of Clean Architecture & Design Patterns
• Work in an agile environment using Jira.
• Flexible, detail-oriented, and excellent ability to work independently and with teams.
• Able to communicate effectively in English and Spanish. Continuously improving English language skills.
• —————————————————–
Projects
Worked in the mantaining and development of project Hotel Nacional de Cuba using Flutter (link below):
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dreamsolutions.hotelnacional

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Flutter: BLoC, GetX, Provider (State Management). DI with GetIt. Reactive Programming with RxDart.
Route Management with GoRoute, Beamer.
• Use of Firebase ecosystem (Crashlytics, Cloud Messaging, Authentication, Firestore,
AppDistribution).
• Integration with Rest API’s, GraphQL
• CI/CD with Codemagic.
• Experience in App responsive layout implementation and optimization.
• Experience in creation of WebApis using Asp.Net Core 6
• Use of Clean Architecture & Design Patterns
• Work in an agile environment using Azure DevOps
• Flexible, detail-oriented, and excellent ability to work independently and with teams.
• Able to communicate effectively in English and Spanish. Continuously improving English language skills.
• In my free time, I am always researching and learning about new technologies, frameworks, etc.
• —————————————————–
Projects
Worked in the development of several projects using Flutter and ASP.Net Core and integrating with Third
Party Applications such as: Payment Processors (Stripe SquareUp), Google Cloud Platform, AWS,
Quickbooks Online, ShineOn, Twilio, Sendgrid, etc

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.insights: C#, Microsoft SQL Server and +5 skills

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained the front-end functionality of some apps
• Developed responsive apps using custom and reusable widgets.
• Maintained and improved existing code using Clean Architecture and applying Design Patterns.
• Worked in an agile environment
• ————————————————————
Projects:
1- Compra Rápido:
Description: Mobile application developed in Flutter (using Clean architecture principles and Provider as
State Management) to facilitate the purchase of products at events, avoiding long waiting lines and
replacing staff that would have to attend to guests.
Technologies Used: Flutter, Google Maps, Django, Ordatic
2- App Negocios
Description: E-Commerce application in which several businesses are listed and the user is given the
option to shop at their favorite store using Stripe as payment processor.
Technologies Used: Flutter, Google Maps, Django, Stripe
3- Das Cortez
Description: Similar to App Negocios, but with the specifications of a particular business with cafeteria
services.
Technologies Used: Flutter, Google Maps, Django, Stripe
